final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendees, 1.0 * attendees / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), city_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_city_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendees) AS average_attendees, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_city_share) AS average_excess_share FROM city_shares CROSS JOIN city_average WHERE share > average_city_share
